content.aim: To determine the number of oscillations a pendulum can perform in a given time frame
objectives: To determine the number of oscillations a pendulum can perform in a given time frame

theory.text: a pendulum swings to and fro in a repeated manner and then we calculate the amount of times it does that in a given time frame eg. 20secs

procedure: Tie a string of 20cm to it
suspend the bob using the string on a vertical frame
allow the bob to ocillate freely
precautions: make sure the path on ocillation is unobstructed
content.conclusion: The pendulum oscillated about 20 times in 20 seconds
